title.zh: 将邦板牙省弗洛里达布兰卡市镇古塔德小学的名称变更为Atanacio Pangan小学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Gutad Elementary School in the Municipality of Floridablanca, Province of Pampanga, to Atanacio Pangan Elementary School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Gutad Elementary School in the Municipality of Floridablanca, Province of Pampanga, to Atanacio Pangan Elementary School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường tiểu học Gutad tại Thị trấn Floridablanca, Tỉnh Pampanga thành Trường tiểu học Atanacio Pangan
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Gutad ในเทศบาล Floridablanca, จังหวัด Pampanga เป็นโรงเรียนประถมศึกษา Atanacio Pangan
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Dasar Gutad di Kotamadya Floridablanca, Provinsi Pampanga menjadi Sekolah Dasar Atanacio Pangan
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Rendah Gutad di Perbandaran Floridablanca, Wilayah Pampanga menjadi Sekolah Rendah Atanacio Pangan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1963/ra_3577_1963.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Gutad Elementary School in the Municipality of Floridablanca, Province of Pampanga, is hereby changed to Atanacio Pangan Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1963.
